Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: Toucan Learn website Getting started step illustration, PNG, landscape 960 x 600 (8:5).
Reference images are style and character references only; create a completely NEW scene.
Match their warm flat hand-drawn illustration style with subtle paper texture, thin magenta outlines, simple solid colour shapes, and warm cream background (#f0e9db). Exactly ONE Toucan Learn toucan: dark teal body, cream face and throat, large orange beak with magenta tip, pink feet, friendly expressive eye. Include a sage-green pencil near or held by the toucan. No people, no other birds, no chicks, no faces on devices, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.
Compose a generous, clearly readable central scene filling most of the canvas with small safe margins; preserve whole beak, tail and feet. The artwork will be shown in a wide horizontal card panel. Step 01, Start with a free session: the toucan sits at a sage-green desk with an open laptop, raises one wing in a welcoming wave, and has a simple clipboard beside the laptop. Laptop screen contains only a friendly abstract speech bubble, no person or bird.
images.qa_refinement: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached Toucan Learn illustration. Keep exactly ONE toucan, the same friendly dark teal body, cream face and throat, orange/magenta beak, pink feet, warm cream paper background, flat hand-drawn style and fine magenta outlines. Keep the overall palette and balanced landscape composition. Use physically consistent object perspective, exactly two wings, two legs (which can be naturally obscured by furniture), one beak and one tail. No humans, no extra birds, no chicks, no human hands, no warped pseudo-text, no readable text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Landscape PNG, 960 x 600, 8:5. Correct the LAPTOP ORIENTATION. The toucan is behind the desk, using the keyboard, and waves with its other wing. The laptop's keyboard and display must face the TOUCAN, never opposite directions. We, in front of the desk, should see the plain sage-green BACK of the laptop's screen (a solid opaque lid, no display, no speech bubble or screen graphics visible to us), with the keyboard naturally on the far side nearest the bird. Show the keyboard only as a small foreshortened strip behind the lid if needed. Keep the desk, clipboard and sage-green pencil resting on it. Make the clipboard sheet blank or contain only faint illegible strokes, oriented towards the bird. Preserve two clearly coherent wings: one resting on the far side of the desk, one raised in a welcome wave.
